user.title: Calendar Helper
user.description: Configure Calendar Helper to add action support for deleting local calendar events.

data.register_calendar_services: Also register actions under calendar.* domain (e.g. calendar.delete_event)

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of Calendar Helper is required.

data.register_calendar_services: Also register actions under calendar.* domain (e.g. calendar.delete_event)

delete_event.name: Delete Event
delete_event.description: Delete a specific event from a local calendar by its UID or summary and time range.

uid.name: Event UID
uid.description: The unique identifier of the calendar event to delete.

summary.name: Summary / Title
summary.description: The summary or title of the event to delete (used if UID is not provided).

summary_match_mode.name: Summary Match Mode
summary_match_mode.description: How to match the summary against calendar events.

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: The recurrence ID if targeting a specific instance of a recurring event.

recurrence_range.name: Recurrence Range
recurrence_range.description: Range of recurring events to delete.

start_date_time.name: Search Start Datetime
start_date_time.description: Start of time range to search for the event (if matching by summary).

end_date_time.name: Search End Datetime
end_date_time.description: End of time range to search for the event (if matching by summary).

start_date.name: Search Start Date
start_date.description: Start date to search for all-day events.

end_date.name: Search End Date
end_date.description: End date to search for all-day events.

delete_events.name: Delete Events
delete_events.description: Delete multiple events from a local calendar based on summary, description, location, or list of UIDs.

uids.name: List of UIDs
uids.description: Optional list of event UIDs to delete.

description.name: Description Filter
description.description: Filter events whose description contains this text.

location.name: Location Filter
location.description: Filter events whose location contains this text.

start_date_time.name: Start Datetime
start_date_time.description: Search window start time (defaults to 30 days ago).

end_date_time.name: End Datetime
end_date_time.description: Search window end time (defaults to 365 days ahead).

all_time.name: Search All Time
all_time.description: Search the entire calendar timeline (1970 to 2099).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of events to delete.

delete_all.name: Delete All (Safety Override)
delete_all.description: Must be set to true if deleting events without providing any filters.

dry_run.name: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If enabled, returns the events that would be deleted without actually deleting them.

clear_calendar.name: Clear Calendar
clear_calendar.description: Bulk remove all events, past events, or future events from a local calendar.

confirm.name: Confirm Action
confirm.description: Safety confirmation. Must be checked (true) to execute the deletion.

only_past.name: Clear Only Past Events
only_past.description: Clear only events that have already ended prior to now.

only_future.name: Clear Only Future Events
only_future.description: Clear only events that start in the future after now.

dry_run.name: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If enabled, lists the events that would be cleared without modifying the calendar.
